gaps.sentence: There's a growing ___ (AWARE) of mental health issues.
The ___ (DECIDE) to close the factory was announced yesterday.

gaps.explanation: 'Cause drowsiness' — the quality noun from drowsy.

gaps.sentence: It is ___ (DENY) that the policy has failed.
gaps.explanation: 'It is undeniable that …' — adjective meaning cannot be denied.

gaps.sentence: She's a leading ___ (SCIENCE) in climate research.

gaps.explanation: 'Trustworthy' = deserving trust; 'trusted' also works but 'trustworthy' is the quality.

gaps.sentence: Do not be ___ (PATIENT) with the trainees — everyone learns at a different pace.
gaps.explanation: 'Do not be impatient' — the negative adjective fits the advice against frustration.

gaps.sentence: Drive ___ (CARE) — the mountain road has hairpin bends.
gaps.explanation: An adverb is needed to modify 'drive': carefully.
